root_cause_verification.rationale: The root cause was that happy-daemon-dev.service used /usr/bin/happy (symlinked to /root/happy/ production code), causing all dev-specific fixes to be ignored. The fix changes ExecStart/ExecStop to directly invoke /usr/bin/node with /root/happy-dev/packages/happy-cli/dist/index.mjs, ensuring the dev daemon runs dev code. systemctl show confirms systemd has loaded the new config with path=/usr/bin/node.

build_verification.skip_reason: Changes are to systemd service config and hook scripts only. No code was compiled or deployed. The dev binary at /root/happy-dev/packages/happy-cli/dist/index.mjs already exists from prior builds. Daemon restart is explicitly forbidden by task constraints.
